new_jobs.title: Business Planning Specialist, Emerging Affluent Segment 數位客群經營
new_jobs.jd: **Job Description** We are seeking a highly motivated and analytical Business Planning Specialist to support the Emerging Affluent Segment within the Consumer Banking Group. This role will drive segment strategy, annual planning, performance management, and management reporting to deliver sustainable customer, AUM, and revenue growth. The successful candidate will translate data and market insights into actionable priorities, coordinate cross-functional execution, and provide clear recommendations to senior management. Segment Strategy & Business Planning: * Support the development and regular refresh of the Emerging Affluent segment strategy, strategic priorities, and multi-year growth roadmap. * Lead annual business planning, target setting, forecasting, and resource prioritization across customer acquisition, AUM, revenue, engagement, and upgrades. * Translate enterprise and Consumer Banking priorities into clear segment initiatives, milestones, and accountable execution plans. Performance Management & Business Analytics: * Establish and maintain a robust performance management framework covering customer, AUM, revenue, product penetration, engagement, retention, and upgrade metrics. * Monitor performance against plan, identify gaps and emerging trends, and conduct root-cause analysis to recommend corrective actions. * Partner with Data, Finance, Product, Digital Banking, and frontline teams to ensure consistent performance definitions, reliable reporting, and actionable business insights. Management Reporting & Strategic Insights: * Prepare concise, insight-led business reviews, dashboards, and executive updates for senior management and governance forums. * Synthesize business performance, customer insights, market trends, and competitive intelligence into clear implications and recommendations. Initiative Governance & Cross-Functional Coordination: * Coordinate the portfolio of strategic initiatives supporting acquisition, activation, AUM growth, cross-buy, retention, and Affluent upgrades. * Track milestones, dependencies, risks, and business outcomes; facilitate timely escalation and resolution of execution issues. * Drive alignment across Segment, Product, Digital, Data, Finance, Operations, and Risk to deliver agreed priorities. Financial Planning, Governance & Continuous Improvement: * Support budget planning, financial forecasting, and benefit tracking to ensure resources are deployed against the highest-impact priorities * Maintain effective governance routines, decision logs, and follow-up mechanisms to strengthen accountability and execution discipline. * Identify opportunities to improve planning processes, management information, and operating rhythms as the segment scales. **Qualifications** * 5+ years of experience in business planning, strategy, performance management, or customer segment management within Consumer Banking, Wealth Management, or a related industry. * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Marketing, or a related field. * Strong analytical, financial modeling, forecasting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business implications. * Proven ability to manage cross-functional planning and governance, influence stakeholders, and drive execution in a complex organization. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing executive-level business reviews and recommendations.

new_jobs.title: AI Engineer, Forward Deployment Pod - Transformation Office
new_jobs.jd: 瀏覽公司官網 **\*Please Submit English Resume** **\*Please note that applicants should currently reside in Taiwan, as this position does not provide relocation support.** **[Overview]** The AI Engineer is a forward deployed engineer in the Forward Deployment Pod, the Transformation Office’s embedded build unit, and develops the pod’s AI solutions end to end: the backend services and agents, the backend-for-frontend layer the product UI consumes, the database schema and migrations, and the AWS infrastructure they run on. That covers packaged skills with role-based access, MCP servers that bridge the company’s assistants into ViewSonic systems and data, and the retrieval and evaluation behind them. Capability is built once and consumed from Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini alike. The role also carries the pod’s applied AI research and tooling evaluation, so the pod knows what is buildable before departments ask. The position requires strong Python and backend engineering across the full stack, production experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks, and a disciplined approach to evaluation, safety and cost. The ideal candidate treats prompts, tools and retrieval as tested software, judges quality with evaluation sets rather than demos, ships the cheapest tier that solves the problem, and can explain to a non-technical department head exactly what the system will and will not do. **[Job Description]** * **Build Skills and MCP Servers** – Design and ship Tier 1 packaged skills (role-based access control, published through the skill portal) and Tier 2 MCP servers (access scoped per connector, actions logged and auditable) that expose ViewSonic systems and data to Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini from one codebase. * **Develop AI Solutions End to End** – Own every layer of a shipped solution: Python/FastAPI backend services and agents, the backend-for-frontend layer (Next.js route handlers or a dedicated API) that serves the product UI, the PostgreSQL schema with forward-only migrations (Atlas) and pgvector, and the AWS infrastructure (ECS Fargate, RDS, ALB) defined as code (Terraform/Terragrunt or CDK) and deployed through GitHub Actions. * **Design Agentic Workflows** – Build tool-using agents, retrieval over company data (embeddings, pgvector) and structured-output pipelines that automate validated departmental workflows; deliver the smallest sufficient tier within the one-month rule, with written justification for anything above it. * **Evaluate and Harden** – Own the evaluation harness, regression tests and guardrails for every LLM feature the pod ships: PII redaction on input, output scanning, prompt-injection defences and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications controls; track quality, latency and cost per workflow and use the numbers to decide what ships. * **Research and Benchmark** – Run continuous applied AI research and tooling evaluation (models, agent frameworks, the MCP specification, vendor features); benchmark departmental problems against market standards; write short, evidence-backed proposals and prototypes for the pod and its departments. * **Integrate and Hand Over** – Instrument shipped capability so sustained usage is read from platform analytics; write runbooks and handover documentation; transfer ownership to the department, the pod or the AI pod as an explicit decision; adapt to re-prioritisation between cycles. **[Requirements]** * 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in Python (typed, tested, production code), including 1+ year building and shipping LLM-backed features or agents to real users. * Hands-on production experience with at least one major LLM API (Anthropic, OpenAI or Google Gemini), including tool/function calling, structured outputs and retrieval-augmented generation. * Demonstrated evaluation practice: has built evaluation sets or harnesses, measured the effect of prompt, model or retrieval changes, and used the results to decide what shipped. * Proven delivery of a solution end to end: backend APIs and services (FastAPI or equivalent), a backend-for-frontend or API layer consumed by a web UI, relational database design and migrations (PostgreSQL), and cloud deployment (AWS preferred) with infrastructure as code and CI/CD. * Effective communicator in English, able to explain AI capability and limits to senior non-technical stakeholders across regions, and to deliver high-quality outcomes in short, re-prioritised build cycles. **【Preferred Qualifications】** * Built an MCP server or an equivalent assistant integration (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini connectors or plugins). * Prompt-programming or agent frameworks (DSPy, LangGraph or similar), pgvector and embedding models. * Security background for LLM systems (OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, PII handling); Terragrunt/Terraform or AWS CDK and Atlas migrations in production.

new_jobs.jd: AI 正在改變企業的行銷與服務方式。從 AI 智能客服、GPT Ads，到 GEO 生成式引擎優化，企業需要的不只是新工具，更是能理解商業需求、協助落地應用的合作夥伴。 現在，我們正在尋找對 AI 充滿好奇、樂於挑戰、熱愛開發商機的業務夥伴，一起拓展 AI 行銷市場！ 你將推廣的 AI 服務 01｜AI 智能客服與 AI Agent 協助企業導入 24 小時 AI 智能客服、自動化服務與知識庫應用，提升服務效率，創造更多商機轉換機會。 02｜GPT Ads 新型態 AI 廣告 推廣 GPT Ads 廣告服務與企業行銷方案，協助品牌掌握 AI 對話情境中的廣告機會，探索新型態的行銷策略。 03｜GEO 生成式引擎優化 透過品牌能見度分析與健檢，協助企業了解品牌在 AI 搜尋與回答中的曝光狀況，並提供 GEO 優化、AI 搜尋內容策略與顧問服務。 04｜AI 行銷整合與創新應用 依企業需求，提供 AI 行銷工具、自動化應用、內容行銷與品牌曝光策略等客製化解決方案，並持續探索新型 AI 商業服務。 你的工作內容 開發企業客戶，推廣 AI 行銷與相關科技服務。 深入了解客戶需求，提出合適的 AI 解決方案。 負責產品簡報、商務提案、報價與合約洽談。 經營客戶關係，發掘後續合作與擴大服務的機會。 與行銷、技術及導入團隊協作，推動提案落地與成交。 掌握 AI 產業趨勢，探索新的商業合作機會。 我們期待這樣的你 喜歡與人溝通，對業務開發充滿熱情。 對 ChatGPT、AI Agent、數位廣告或 AI 行銷感興趣。 主動積極，樂於學習新產品、新技術。 具備良好的簡報、溝通與問題解決能力。 有 B2B 業務、廣告代理商、SaaS 或數位行銷經驗者尤佳。 不需要具備程式開發能力。 接觸 AI 客服、GPT Ads、GEO 等新興服務，拓展傳統廣告以外的事業視野。 多元服務，開創更多合作機會 如果你不想只做傳統廣告業務，期待投入 AI 新創領域，歡迎加入吉智能 ORANGEAI，一起讓 AI 成為企業成長的助力！銷售 / CRM銷售顧問
